clauses: Take the overall average budget amount as the mean over all individual budget lines.
Take the overall average budget amount as the mean of the per-event average amounts.
readings: Which events have an above-average budget amount? For each event (`budget.link_to_event`), using the average `amount` across its budget lines and ignoring missing amounts, show the event link, its average amount, how much it beats the overall average budget amount, and its average minus the mean among those above-average events. List the top 10 by that last gap, largest first. Take the overall average budget amount as the mean over all individual budget lines.

Which events have an above-average budget amount? For each event (`budget.link_to_event`), using the average `amount` across its budget lines and ignoring missing amounts, show the event link, its average amount, how much it beats the overall average budget amount, and its average minus the mean among those above-average events. List the top 10 by that last gap, largest first. Take the overall average budget amount as the mean of the per-event average amounts.
queries:
WITH ev AS (
    SELECT link_to_event, AVG(amount) AS avg_amount
    FROM budget
    WHERE amount IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY link_to_event
),
overall AS (
    SELECT AVG(amount) AS overall_avg FROM budget WHERE amount IS NOT NULL
),
above AS (
    SELECT ev.link_to_event, ev.avg_amount, ev.avg_amount - overall.overall_avg AS diff_overall
    FROM ev, overall
    WHERE ev.avg_amount > overall.overall_avg
)
SELECT link_to_event,
       avg_amount,
       diff_overall,
       avg_amount - (SELECT AVG(avg_amount) FROM above) AS diff_above_mean
FROM above
ORDER BY diff_above_mean DESC
LIMIT 10;
WITH ev AS (
  SELECT link_to_event, AVG(amount) AS avg_amount
  FROM budget
  WHERE amount IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY link_to_event
),
overall AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_amount) AS overall_avg FROM ev
),
above AS (
  SELECT ev.link_to_event, ev.avg_amount, ev.avg_amount - overall.overall_avg AS beats_overall
  FROM ev, overall
  WHERE ev.avg_amount > overall.overall_avg
)
SELECT link_to_event,
       avg_amount,
       beats_overall,
       avg_amount - (SELECT AVG(avg_amount) FROM above) AS gap_from_above_mean
FROM above
ORDER BY gap_from_above_mean DESC
LIMIT 10;
